payload.artist_html: S. W. Evers, E. Panigot, H. Petermann, B. S. Rubidge, B. S. Bever & T. R. Lyson
payload.credit_html: "Labyrinth morphology of Eunotosaurus africanus in the context of semicircular canal shape variation across amniotes"
payload.description_html: 3D renderings of both labyrinths of Eunotosaurus africanus (BP/1/7852). A–C, left labyrinth. D–F, right labyrinth. A, D, lateral view. B, E, posterior view. C, F, dorsal view. Dashed line in B denotes the partial imprint of the membranous posterior semicircular duct and ampulla in the surface of the second common canal. Abbreviations: aam, anterior ampulla; asc, anterior semicircular canal; cc, common crus; fov, fenestra ovalis area; lam, lateral ampulla; lsc, lateral semicircular canal; pam, posterior ampulla; psc, posterior semicircular canal; scc, second common canal; VII, facial nerve (cranial nerve VII) canal.
